Based on my search, here are the current number of MLA and MP seats in Telangana:

## MLA Seats (Legislative Assembly)

**119 seats** - The Telangana Legislative Assembly currently has 119 elected members. This was established when Telangana was formed as a separate state in 2014 under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014.

**Note:** The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 had provisioned for increasing Telangana's assembly seats from **119 to 153**, but this increase has not yet been implemented due to constitutional constraints. Article 170(3) of the Indian Constitution freezes any delimitation or seat readjustment until after the first census conducted after 2026. The Supreme Court dismissed a plea in July 2025 seeking early implementation of this increase, citing these constitutional limitations.

## MP Seats (Parliament)

- **Lok Sabha (Lower House): 17 seats**
- **Rajya Sabha (Upper House): 7 seats**

So in total, Telangana has **24 Members of Parliament** (17 in Lok Sabha + 7 in Rajya Sabha).

---

| Lok Sabha MP | 17 |
